name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Reroute.comparator_span_finrank_le
title: The comparator block of the prefix rows at a cut spans at most one direction per state
statement: For a state map kappa from prefixes to a finite set S and a common vector rho indexed by a finite type R, the span of the vectors (s, r) -> [s = kappa x] * rho r over all prefixes x has dimension at most card S.
